svg.title: HyLA fusion and hypergraph-guided bidirectional SSM for multimodal MOT
svg.desc: Paired real RGB and event inputs are fused by HyLA at dark3, dark4 and dark5. YOLOX detections and hypergraph-guided SSM motion predictions enter association to produce tracked objects with IDs. Real inputs and output are extracted unchanged from the final overall-framework Visio document.
